dataset_citation: K. Fricke, R. G. Nascimento, F. A. C. Viana, An accelerated Life Testing Dataset for Lithium-Ion Batteries with Constant and Variable Loading Conditions, NASA PCoE / PML-UCF, v0.0.1, 2023.
design: Standardised-probe certification experiment. The grade of a pack is fixed by its hazard rate under its own operational load; the evidence channel is the pack's REFERENCE discharge (mission_type=0, constant 2.52 A on every pack). The question is the paper's question: how many standardised probe runs are needed before a Safe pack can be separated from an Unsafe pack, and is there a floor that no n can beat.

grade.rule: tertiles of h over included packs; S = lowest tertile, U = highest tertile, A = middle
grade.note: computed at freeze time, before any Delta / D computation; values recorded in results/freeze_v02.json

evidence.binariser: b(f) = 1 if f >= pooled median of f over reference discharges of included packs (unweighted); cut points recorded in results/freeze_v02.json

smoothing.rule: add-delta on the per-pack empirical pmf

test.n_grid_cap_reason: count-state enumeration C(n+K-1, K-1) is exact and exhaustive; K=8 at n=20 is 888030 states

gates.G0_feasibility: median over theta of (#action bins with >=5 missions) >= 3  [v01 axis; FAILED, recorded]
gates.G1_bound: D_{alpha,beta}(E,n) <= min{1, alpha + beta + Delta_E(n)} at every n and every K
gates.G2_attained: an adversarially selected two-point sub-experiment attains equality to 1e-8
gates.G4_nstar_sion: n* = min{n : Delta_E(n) <= 0.05} reported (inf allowed); and |gamma*(n) - Delta_E(n)/2| <= 1e-8 at every n
gates.G6_data_processing: Delta_{K4} <= Delta_{K8} and Delta_{K2} <= Delta_{K4} at every shared n, on the strictly nested chain above; and Delta_{(X,g(X))} = Delta_X
gates.G9_heldout_packs: split included packs by pack-id parity into two disjoint halves; G1 must hold on each half independently

reporting: every gate is reported as run. No threshold, menu, quantiser or feature is changed after this file is hashed. Any deviation is recorded in docs/ERRATA.md.
